predictions.label: Auto predictions
predictions.description: When the mod reports a battle start, Three Marks opens an “over N damage?” prediction and resolves it from the result. Requires Twitch Affiliate or Partner status.
predictions.reconnectHint: Reconnect Twitch to grant the new permission predictions need.
predictions.panel: The Twitch panel extension shows viewers your session and marks.

settings.description: The client settings you play with: graphics, camera, sensitivity, zoom, sight, markers, sound, hardware and mods. Viewers see them on your settings page.
settings.applyNote: Viewers can apply your settings through the mod in the hangar. The mod leaves screen resolution and sensitivity alone unless the viewer turns them on.
settings.importedNote: Values from preferences.xml are in the form — review them and save.

noProfile.title: Create your profile first
noProfile.description: Settings are published on your streamer page. Fill in the profile — page address and name — and come back here.

mod.title: From the game via the mod
mod.description: The Three Marks mod reads your settings straight from the client and sends them to your profile — no files, no copying.

steps.bind: Install the modpack and link it in your account.
steps.share: In the hangar, open the mod window and press “Send game settings to the site”.
steps.target: Choose “To my profile on the site” — the settings show up here marked “from the game via the mod”.

mod.hint: The mod never sends your login, password or account data.

xml.title: Upload preferences.xml
xml.description: Pick the client settings file. It usually lives here:
xml.privacy: The file is read only in your browser and is never uploaded. We take graphics, camera and sensitivity values only; login, tokens and encoded sections are skipped.
xml.invalid: Could not read the file. Pick preferences.xml from the client folder.
xml.empty: No known settings found in the file.
